reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Silky Moisture Sun Cream 50ml Set (+15ml)
reviews.text: I love this sun cream so much. It does not feel thick or smell. It leaves no white cast on my dark skin and doesn’t make it any more oily. This is my fourth time purchasing and will do so again soon.
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢支防曬。用落唔會覺得稠，亦都冇味。喺我呢種深色皮膚上面都唔會泛白，亦都唔會令皮膚更加油。我已經係第四次回購，好快會再買。

reviews.shade: Anua Heartleaf Silky Moisture Sun Cream 50ml Set (+15ml)
reviews.text: こちらは友人からの頼まれものです！気に入っているそうです。
reviews.zh: 呢個係幫朋友買嘅！聽講佢好鍾意用。
